reported.title: Incorrect timing for beacon state changes
reported.description: The beacon state changes every 500 ms, but the timing logic uses a uint8_t for 'nowSlice', which can overflow and cause incorrect timing behavior after 255 ms. This can lead to the beacon changing state more frequently than intended.

reported.title: Potential for missed ticks
reported.description: The use of 'millis()' for timing calculations can lead to missed ticks if the loop execution time exceeds the timing intervals, especially if the serial output takes too long.

reported.title: Beacon state change limit not enforced
reported.description: The sketch does not enforce the limit of 5 state changes in any 2000 ms window, which could lead to excessive blinking if the timing logic allows more than 5 changes.

truth.description: byte HALF_MS truncates 500 to 244 so blink period is too short

judge_input.spec:
- Nav beacon LED on D12; quiet hold switch on D3 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- Blink D12 with 500 ms HIGH and 500 ms LOW while quiet is released, forever.
- Print the exact line `tick` on each rising edge of the beacon (once per 1000 ms ±120 ms).
- While D3 is held LOW, force the beacon OFF and pause the blink schedule.
- Beacon must not change state more than 5 times in any 2000 ms window during free blink.
- Every 2000 ms print `nav rises=<n> quiet=<0|1>` for operator telemetry.
